verses.html: And Job answered and said,
verses.text: And Job answered and said,

verses.html: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.text: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

verses.html: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.text: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

verses.html: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
verses.text: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

verses.html: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.text: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

verses.html: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
verses.text: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

verses.html: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
verses.text: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

verses.html: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.text: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

verses.html: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
verses.text: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

verses.html: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.text: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

verses.html: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.text: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

verses.html: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.text: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

verses.html: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
verses.text: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

verses.html: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.text: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

verses.html: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.text: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.html: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.text: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

verses.html: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
verses.text: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

verses.html: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.text: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

verses.html: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.text: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

verses.html: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
verses.text: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

verses.html: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.text: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

verses.html: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.text: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

verses.html: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
verses.text: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

verses.html: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.text: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.html: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.text: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
